lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately 5-6 identifiable horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, extending across the lateral mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the centroid clusters, creating a rectilinear grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient showing highlights on the superior surface and shadow on the inferior surface, extending from the post-cranial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7 discrete high-luminance blobs are visible within the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily concentrated in the lower and middle regions of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of smaller, non-grid-aligned luminance points on the rostrum and head region, transitioning into the ordered grid of the lateral flank.
